description_en: You can invoke ListAttempts to obtain the list of contact dialing records for a specified predictive outbound calling Activity under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListAttempts获取指定实例下指定预测式外呼活动的联系人拨打记录列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-attempts --instance-id ccc-test --campaign-id 6badb397-a8b5-40b6-21019d382a09 --start-time 1634115688291 --end-time 1634115698291 --queue-id skillgroup@ccc-test --case-id 60ecb1a2-4480-4d01-bede-c5b7655bfadf --attempt-id job-169769645003250000 --contact-id job-169769645003250000 --agent-id agent@ccc-test --caller 057112340000 --callee 18888880000 --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --criteria '{"caseIds":["964f05a7-fc15-4a05-93a6-cd7421c4459e","5e2d508b-0df6-4077-8099-d3fff51ea6d0","da037029-8c83-4270-a90e-e7734be76af6"]}' --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAttempts

parameters.help_en: Start Time. This parameter is optional. If not specified, it defaults to the Start Time of the predictive outbound dialing Activity. The format is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，非必填，不填默认为预测式外呼活动的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: End Time. This parameter is optional. If not specified, it defaults to the End Time of the predictive outbound dialing Activity. The format is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，非必填，不填默认为预测式外呼活动的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Filter by skill group ID. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty, which means no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按技能组ID过滤，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤
parameters.name: queue_id

parameters.help_en: System-generated contact ID. Customers do not need to concern themselves with this value
parameters.help_zh: 系统生成的联系人ID，客户无需关心
parameters.name: case_id

parameters.help_en: Call record ID, which has the same value as the call ID
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫记录ID，和通话ID取值一样
parameters.name: attempt_id

parameters.help_en: Filter by call ID. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty
parameters.help_zh: 按通话ID过滤，非必填，默认为空
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.help_en: Filter by agent ID. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty
parameters.help_zh: 按坐席ID过滤，非必填，默认为空
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: Filter by caller number. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty
parameters.help_zh: 按主叫号码过滤，非必填，默认为空
parameters.name: caller

parameters.help_en: Filter by called number. Optional. Default is empty
parameters.help_zh: 按被叫号码过滤，非必填，默认为空
parameters.name: callee

parameters.help_en: Page number. The product of PageNumber and PageSize must not exceed 10 000
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，大小取决于PageNumber和PageSize的乘积，两个参数相乘不能大于10000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: Page size. The product of PageNumber and PageSize must not exceed 10 000
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，大小取决于PageNumber和PageSize的乘积，两个参数相乘不能大于10000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Extended query conditions in JSON format. Currently supports caseIds for batch queries
parameters.help_zh: 扩展查询条件。JSON格式，目前支持caseIds，支持caseIds批量查询
parameters.name: criteria

AgentEstablishedTime.description_en: The time when the agent answered the call, in Unix timestamp format, in milliseconds
AgentEstablishedTime.description_zh: 坐席接听时刻，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

AssignAgentTime.description_en: The time when the agent was assigned, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
AssignAgentTime.description_zh: 分配坐席时刻，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

CaseId.description_en: A contact ID generated by the system. Customers do not need to be concerned with this value
CaseId.description_zh: 系统生成的联系人ID，客户无需关心

CustomerEstablishedTime.description_en: The time when the Customer answered the call, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CustomerEstablishedTime.description_zh: 客户接通的时刻，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

CustomerReleasedTime.description_en: The time when the Customer hung up, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CustomerReleasedTime.description_zh: 客户挂机时刻，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

DialTime.description_en: Time when the dial-up was initiated, in UNIX timestamp format, in milliseconds
DialTime.description_zh: 发起拨号的时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

EnqueueTime.description_en: The time when the contact entered the queue, in Unix timestamp format, in milliseconds
EnqueueTime.description_zh: 进入队列时刻，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

EnterIvrTime.description_en: The time when the call was transferred into IVR, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
EnterIvrTime.description_zh: 转接进入IVR时刻，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

IvrDuration.description_en: The duration spent in IVR, in seconds

PageNumber.description_en: Page number. The product of PageNumber and PageSize must not exceed 10 000
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页页码，大小取决于PageNumber和PageSize的乘积，两个参数相乘不能大于10000

PageSize.description_en: Page size. The product of PageNumber and PageSize must not exceed 10 000
PageSize.description_zh: 分页大小，大小取决于PageNumber和PageSize的乘积，两个参数相乘不能大于10000
